_comment: Shared fixture for the omlx model-directory scan. wt (wt/internal/localmodels/sources.go, scanOmlxModels) and modelman (modelman/src/modelman/providers/omlx.py, omlx_model_dirs) must list the same model names for the same tree. Both follow omlx's DIRECTORY rule (discover_models); neither checks weights, which omlx also requires before it registers a model. Both deliberately list nothing for a model dir that holds a Hugging Face cache entry, whether or not omlx can use that entry. Each case lists the files to create under a temporary root (directories are implied; both tests write "{}" into files ending in .json and a short fixed byte string into every other file, because omlx rejects zero-byte weights), the model dir relative to that root, and the names expected, sorted. Read by a Go test in wt/internal/localmodels and a Python test in modelman/tests/contracts; a rule change on either side fails both CI jobs in the same PR.

cases.name: adapters, dot-dirs and empty folders are skipped
a duplicate name is listed once
an HF cache entry is not listed
the model dir is itself one model
fallback: an adapter is not a model
fallback: not taken when the dir holds an HF cache entry (omlx serves the cache model instead)
a missing model dir is no models
